title: Anthropic is working on a system to prove AI models’ identity
summary: Called FlashProve, the system would let anyone check that an AI response really came from the model it claims to be from.
reason: No named model or release action (R1); no paper/benchmark artifact (R2); a system 'being worked on' is not a launched product, deal, or market event (R3); no policy action (R4); not open-source tooling (R5). Only a TechCrunch report of in-development tech.
